column1: # TiDB parser corpus: every single-statement case from pingcap's own parser
# test, with the verdict omni/tidb/parser and TiDB v8.5.5 each give it.
#   omni    accept | reject -- what tidb/parser.Parse does with the statement
#   engine  accept | reject -- whether TiDB v8.5.5 accepts the syntax
#   sql     the statement, verbatim, one line, tabs and newlines excluded by
#           construction; trailing spaces, CR inside literals and non-UTF-8
#           bytes are deliberate and must survive an edit
# See README.md in this directory for provenance, licensing, and how the
# engine column is produced. corpus_oracle_test.go is the only reader.
# A gap closed by a parser change flips its omni column from reject to accept.
# Do not edit a row's engine column to make a test pass: that column records
# what the engine does, and a disagreement with it is the finding.
